name: Orly Kuukou Satsujin Jiken
original_name: オルリー空港殺人事件
source:
Kanae and Akina went to France for the first time abroad and got involved in a murder case. A Southern Tourist tour operator is killed, and Kanae follows victim's schedule from arrival to Paris till return.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
Kanae与Akina第一次出国，来到法国，却卷入了一桩谋杀案。Southern Tourist旅行社的一名领队遇害，Kanae开始追查死者从抵达巴黎到返程期间的行程。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
